description:
Replace byte-exact Name comparison with RFC 4518 normalized string comparison, required for correct name constraints and general DN matching.

Spec references:
- RFC 5280 §7.1 — internationalized names in certificates
- RFC 4518 — Lightweight Directory Access Protocol: Internationalized String Preparation
- RFC 4517 §3.3.19 — Directory String matching rules
- Affects: issuer/subject name linkage in chain_walk, and will be a prerequisite for name constraints processing
notes: Review converged after 1 round. P0=0, P1=0, P2=0. SEC7: running out of real complaints. Final review: PKIX-itb.
title: RFC 4518 DN string normalization for name comparison
